import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static int my_find(String s1, String s2, int start) {
        int pos = s1.indexOf(s2, start);
        return (pos != -1) ? pos : -1;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String s1 = br.readLine().trim();
        String s2 = "";
        String ans = "";
        
        int pos = my_find(s1, "at", 1);
        s2 = s1.substring(0, pos) + '@' + s1.substring(pos + 2);
        
        int i = my_find(s2, "dot", 1);
        int last = 0;
        while (i != -1 && i < s2.length() - 3) {
            ans += s2.substring(last, i) + ".";
            last = i + 3;
            i = my_find(s2, "dot", last);
        }
        ans += s2.substring(last);
        
        System.out.print(ans);
    }
}
